title: Idle Life Game
author: NiceAndSuitable8652
selftext:
Hi All, I vibe coded this free game in lovable and would love to hear that someone enjoyed it. You start off as an 18 year old with a low-paying job and need to earn diplomas and advance through your career in order to start improving your lifestyle (buying your time back) and building businesses and/or passively investing. I think the AI generated images of your careers, businesses and lifestyle and realistic numbers make for a fun and rewarding gameplay. Maybe we even learn a little something about life.. but maybe it's not the right lesson to learn lol.

  
[https://grand-aspirations-game.lovable.app](https://grand-aspirations-game.lovable.app)

  
Thanks!
